request: 配置 Dio 通道 0-3 为输出，初始电平低
config:
```yaml
Dio:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  DioChannel:
    - id: 0
      name: LED_0
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 1
      name: LED_1
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 2
      name: LED_2
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 3
      name: LED_3
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
```

request: 配置 Dio 按钮输入，带上拉电阻
config:
```yaml
Dio:
  DioChannel:
    - id: 0
      name: BUTTON_0
      direction: INPUT
      pull_resistor: PULL_UP
      debounce_time_ms: 50
    - id: 1
      name: BUTTON_1
      direction: INPUT
      pull_resistor: PULL_UP
      debounce_time_ms: 50
```
